status: frozen after aggregate bridge metrics were known and before residual-distribution and cluster-bootstrap scoring
question: How closely does the unchanged squared-coherence candidate reproduce the CLASH lensing-inferred radial field compared with fixed-a0 MOND, a cluster-retuned MOND/RAR diagnostic, and the per-cluster NFW construction?

input.target: CLASH strong-plus-weak-lensing radial acceleration table used by Tian et al. (2020)
input.target_warning: g_obs was obtained by spherical deprojection of individually fit NFW lensing profiles; it is not a raw shear or image-position likelihood

photon_closure.name: same-effective-potential_zero-slip_diagnostic
photon_closure.rule: Identify each model's predicted radial acceleration with the Weyl acceleration that deflects photons; use no gravitational-slip, photon-coupling, or lensing-normalization parameter.
photon_closure.candidate_status: added diagnostic hypothesis, not derived from the current nonrelativistic formula
photon_closure.MOND_status: TeVeS-like comparison convention in which the potential governing dynamics also governs light deflection

candidate.prediction_provenance: five-fold complete-system held-out predictions from a joint 44-BCG plus 20-cluster bridge

GR_plus_per_cluster_NFW.score_status: zero by construction and therefore not an independent goodness-of-fit score

contrasts: candidate minus fixed simple MOND equal-cluster RMSE
candidate minus cluster-retuned RAR equal-cluster RMSE

metrics.forbidden_diagnostic: Report the single post-hoc global multiplier that removes mean log residual, but never use it in primary scores or advancement decisions.

interpretation_rules.beat_fixed_MOND_on_this_derived_target: candidate primary RMSE is lower with the same unchanged settings and zero lensing multiplier
interpretation_rules.dark_matter_closeness: report distance from the NFW-derived target and error-normalized residual; do not interpret NFW's construction zero as independent evidence
interpretation_rules.raw_lensing_claim: withheld unless a theory-neutral image/shear likelihood, complete same-system baryons, an unspent validation set, and a declared relativistic action or closure are all available
interpretation_rules.universality_claim: limited to zero object-specific candidate gravity parameters in the tested bridge
